title: Tighten evaluation-matrix negative assertions to specific refusal causes
outcome: Negative matrix rows distinguish the intended source-currency or evidence-provenance refusal from an unrelated refusal, retaining the existing status, seal and immutable-history assertions.
acceptance: The source-refusal, asserted-note, newer-failed-check and policy-off rows assert specific typed codes or source/evidence refusal reasons rather than generic words such as source, input, bound, eligible or commit.
A focused regression demonstrates that an unrelated refusal cannot satisfy each affected helper while genuine intended refusal and successful controls retain their existing behavior.
